svg.title: Conveyor intercept
svg.desc: A conveyor belt seen from above, moving to the right (arrow). A break beam, tag 1, crosses the belt at 0 m. Red circles show one cell at three times: faded at 0 m (t = 0 s) and 0.20 m (t = 2.0 s), solid at 0.35 m (t = 3.5 s), tag 3. A hollow red circle at 0.50 m (t = 5.0 s) is tag 4. Below, a distance axis from 0 to 0.5 m past the beam, and a bar from 0 to 0.45 m, tag 2.
